description: Société nationale des Chemins de Fer Luxembourgeois: rail datasets is a collection of datasets listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Société nationale des Chemins de Fer Luxembourgeois. Coverage: Société nationale des Chemins de Fer Luxembourgeois. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about rail; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: kilométrage des lignes ferroviaires luxembourgeoises; arrêts et gares des lignes ferroviaires; lignes ferroviaires luxembourgeoises. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-by-sa. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
